nl: Run tools/check.py for each of the services mail, dns in parallel in the background and wait for all of them. Which services failed (non-zero exit code)?

entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

time.sleep(0.3)
failing = {"db", "queue", "mail"}
print(f"{sys.argv[1]}: {'failed' if sys.argv[1] in failing else 'ok'}")
sys.exit(2 if sys.argv[1] in failing else 0)

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/check.py", "mail"] background: true label: "mail"
run ["python3", "tools/check.py", "dns"] background: true label: "dns"
jobs wait: 60s |> filter exit_code != 0 |> select label
reference_bash:
python3 tools/check.py mail > /dev/null & p0=$!
python3 tools/check.py dns > /dev/null & p1=$!
wait $p0 || echo mail failed
wait $p1 || echo dns failed
